newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early losses - MAR 02.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady, recovers early losses - MAR 02.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered early losses on easing of dollar demand and closed mostly steady at 42.8360/8400 to the greenback in interbank trading on Sunday, dealers said. The previous close was at 42.8375/8425.
The local unit was quoted weaker at 42.8430/8480 per dollar in early trade amid queries from some state-owned banks but edged up in the absence of any major deals.
"Some major banks showed interest (in dollars) initially but there were few deals at the end," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished at 5.0 to 5.5 percent, down from a previous 5.5-6.5 percent.
